calendar.caption: Nina's afternoon timetable
calendar.description: All times are in the afternoon. Read the day, activity and time together.

town.caption: A small neighbourhood
town.description: North is at the top. The first row is north of the second row. West is left and east is right. A place directly below another place is in the same column.

items.english: Nina has a headache.

items.maltese: Hi għajjiena u tibqa' d-dar filgħodu.
items.english: She is tired and stays at home in the morning.
Her brother goes to school.
In the evening Nina reads a book.

groups.title: Nina stays at home — your turn

question.english: Talk about how you feel today.

answer.maltese: Illum inħossni għajjien. Għandi uġigħ f'rasi. Illum nibqa' d-dar.
answer.english: Today I feel tired. I have a headache. Today I am staying at home.

items.maltese: Liam jipprattika l-futbol nhar ta' Sibt.
items.english: Liam practises football on Saturdays.

items.maltese: Oħtu Emma tipprattika t-tenis nhar ta' Ħadd.
items.english: His sister Emma practises tennis on Sundays.
After football Liam drinks water.
Emma drinks a glass of milk in the morning.

question.english: Talk about sport and what you drink.

answer.maltese: Nipprattika l-għawm nhar ta' Tlieta. Wara l-għawm nixrob l-ilma. Oħti tipprattika t-tenis.
answer.english: I practise swimming on Tuesdays. After swimming I drink water. My sister practises tennis.

items.maltese: Nina għandha tliet attivitajiet din il-ġimgħa.
items.english: Nina has three activities this week.
On Monday she has a Maltese lesson at four.
On Tuesday she practises swimming at five.

items.maltese: Il-Ħamis għandha lezzjoni tal-pjanu fit-tlieta u nofs.
items.english: On Thursday she has a piano lesson at half past three.

question.maltese: Meta tagħlaq sninek? X'tagħmel matul il-ġimgħa?
question.english: When is your birthday? What do you do during the week?

answer.maltese: Għeluq snini fit-tnejn ta' April. Nhar it-Tnejn għandi lezzjoni. Il-lezzjoni tibda fl-erbgħa.
answer.english: My birthday is on the second of April. On Monday I have a lesson. The lesson starts at four.

groups.title: An evening at a village festa

items.maltese: Rita tmur il-festa ma' ħuha filgħaxija.
items.english: Rita goes to the festa with her brother in the evening.

items.maltese: Fil-pjazza hemm banda u ħafna bandalori.
items.english: In the square there is a band and there are many banners.

items.maltese: Rita tħobb il-mużika u tiekol il-qubbajt.
items.english: Rita likes the music and eats nougat.
Her brother likes watching the coloured fireworks.

groups.title: An evening at a village festa — your turn

question.maltese: Iddeskrivi festa u għid x'jogħġbok fiha.
question.english: Describe a festa and say what you like about it.

answer.maltese: Jogħġobni l-marċ. Togħġobni l-mużika. Jogħġbuni l-bandalori. Fil-festa niekol il-qubbajt.
answer.english: I like the march. I like the music. I like the banners. At the festa I eat nougat.

items.maltese: Din hi z-zija ta' Lara. Jisimha Anna.
items.english: This is Lara's aunt. Her name is Anna.

items.maltese: Anna għandha xagħarha qasir u għajnejha ħodor.
items.english: Anna has short hair and green eyes.
She is a teacher and teaches Maltese.

items.maltese: Ħuha Mark hu pustier. Iqassam l-ittri filgħodu.
items.english: Her brother Mark is a postman and delivers letters in the morning.

groups.title: A family and their jobs — your turn

question.english: Describe a person and their job.

answer.maltese: Oħti għandha xagħarha twil. Hi għalliema. Tgħallem il-Malti. Dan il-ktieb tagħha.
answer.english: My sister has long hair. She is a teacher. She teaches Maltese. This book is hers.

groups.title: Plans for work and free time

items.maltese: Marta tixtieq issir tabiba biex tgħin lin-nies.
items.english: Marta would like to become a doctor to help people.
Her brother David would like to become a cook.
In her free time Marta reads books.
David bakes cakes with his grandmother.

groups.title: Plans for work and free time — your turn

question.maltese: X'tixtieq issir? X'tħobb tagħmel fil-ħin liberu?
question.english: What would you like to become? What do you like doing in your free time?

answer.maltese: Nixtieq insir kok. Fil-ħin liberu nsajjar il-kejkijiet. Inħobb ukoll naqra l-kotba.
answer.english: I would like to become a cook. In my free time I bake cakes. I also like reading books.

items.english: The post office is next to the church.

items.maltese: Il-knisja tinsab bejn il-posta u l-forn.
items.english: The church is between the post office and the bakery.
The garden is below the post office on the plan.
The school is below the bakery on the plan.
Tomorrow Lara is going to the garden.

question.maltese: Iddeskrivi r-raħal tiegħek u għid x'se tagħmel għada.
question.english: Describe your village and say what you are going to do tomorrow.

answer.maltese: Il-posta tinsab ħdejn il-knisja. Il-ġnien jinsab wara l-iskola. Għada se mmur il-ġnien.
answer.english: The post office is next to the church. The garden is behind the school. Tomorrow I am going to the garden.
